title: Dueling Generators
description: Simulate two pseudo-random generators and compare their lowest 16 bits.
writeup:
## Approach

Two generators repeatedly produce values using a linear congruential formula. After each pair of values is produced, the judge compares their lowest 16 bits. The task is to count how many times these bits match.

## Part 1

Each generator uses its own multiplication factor and modulus. Starting from the given initial values, we generate 40 million pairs. For each pair, we compare the lowest 16 bits using a bitmask (`value & 0xFFFF`). The number of matches is the answer.

## Part 2

The generators now apply additional rules: Generator A only keeps values divisible by 4, and Generator B only keeps values divisible by 8. We generate 5 million such filtered pairs and again compare their lowest 16 bits. Using Python generators avoids storing large sequences and keeps the solution efficient.

The puzzle is a mix of modular arithmetic, bitwise operations, and efficient iteration.
